prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent PNG unit sprite for an elevated quarter-view strategy game.
Image 1 is the edit target and sole source of character identity/design. Image 2 is the USER-APPROVED reworked Legolas showing the desired drawing direction. Image 3 is the actual approved style contact sheet. Other images, if present, are supporting actual style examples only.
Redraw ONLY the unit from image 1, matching the same family as Tauriel, Fingolfin, Helm Hammerhand, Imrahil, Gorbag, Werewolf, Cave Drake and the approved Legolas. Handcrafted fantasy RPG pixel sprite with precise dark contours, tidy visible pixel clusters and stepped edges, broad coherent shadows and restrained highlights. Give cloth, leather, hair, armor or creature hide distinct grouped shadows instead of uniformly smooth rounded airbrushed/3D shading. Native small sprite, not an illustration scaled down; no photographic details, realism, plastic gloss, elaborate concept art or new costume.
Preserve the input character's exact original identity, species, coloration, gender, recognizable anatomy, relative body proportions and silhouette, hair, beard, helmet/crown, facial markings, outfit, emblems, cloak, armor pieces, ALL existing weapons with the same type and count, existing held objects and mount if any. Preserve exactly the original number of characters/animals. Do not invent missing equipment, replace weapon types, enlarge the head, or simplify distinguishing motifs. For mounted units keep the rider and the same animal and tack, do not dismount. For monsters keep the creature's exact species/anatomy, no human redesign, correct number of legs and wings.
Match the reference elevated quarter view: visible top of head and shoulders, foreshortened legs, facing toward bottom of image. Retain the original stance and weapon placement; where a source is flatter/frontal, adjust only the elevation to fit the reference. Full standalone body/object, no cropped weapons/ears/wings/feet, no scenery, no floor or miniature base, no text, labels, watermark or detached ground shadow. Existing meaningful character smoke/fire or magic stays restrained and attached; no invented aura.
TRUE TRANSPARENT background. ONE finished standalone sprite. Preserve original footprint and framing; exact native canvas and alpha occupancy will be normalized after generation without stretching or repainting. Redraw style only.
Unit ID: grimbeorn; identity: Grimbeorn (그림베오른). Source unit role: hero. Source canvas 440x440 pixels. Preserve the actual source-image equipment and design even if names or metadata suggest something else. Exact body proportions and count are determined by image 1; references set only rendering style, camera family and shading.
recovery_evidence: Unique exact RGBA pixel match after native normalization; actual batch prompt template verified against 137 recorded batch calls.
